title: App Store app preview, iPad 13"/12.9"/11"/10.5" (1200x1600)
description: App previews for iPad display sizes that accept 1200x1600 (portrait) or 1600x1200 (landscape). Same encoding rules as the iPhone profile.

sources.title: Apple Developer: App Store Connect Help, App preview specifications

notes: The 9.7" iPad takes 900x1200 / 1200x900, and the 12.9" iPad also accepts those. Extend this profile and change video.size if you target them.
Apple publishes a 30 fps maximum but no minimum. The 25 fps lower bound is a conservative choice and only warns.
Apple's 10-12 Mbps is a target for H.264, so the bitrate rule only warns.
